name: CityCube-Bench
description: CityCube-Bench is a city-scale visual benchmark designed for evaluation of urban scene understanding tasks using volumetric/cubic representations. It focuses on tasks such as detection, segmentation, and tracking of urban objects over spatio-temporal data and is intended for benchmarking perception systems for smart-city and autonomous driving research. The dataset provides structured evaluation splits and metrics appropriate for dense urban scenarios.
reputation: A newer dataset with growing interest in urban perception and smart-city research communities but not yet a widely established standard.
